purpose: Governed source identities for U.S. Employment Situation first-print actuals and doctoral-research market consensus. This contract authorizes source audit/reconstruction only; it does not authorize model scoring or forecast/decision writes.
point_in_time_rule: For any event at t, a model input is eligible only when provider semantics support that it is a pre-release consensus associated with that event. When exact pre-release update time is not proven, reconstructed consensus is eligible no earlier than the official BLS release timestamp. Current-vintage substitution for historical first-print actuals or post-result provider switching is forbidden.

consensus_provider_policy.professional_benchmark_if_entitled: Bloomberg Economic Calendar historical latest pre-release panel consensus
forbidden_substitutes: per-origin provider switching after viewing model results
post-release consensus invented from another provider
current-vintage BLS/FRED value substituted for historical first print
consensus_provider_policy.investing_forecast_semantic: Forecast/Consensus = consensus estimate from economists before the data is released, per Investing.com Economic Calendar FAQ
consensus_provider_policy.investing_availability_semantics: Unless exact pre-release forecast-update timestamp is separately proven, preserved historical consensus is eligible no earlier than the official BLS release timestamp and must be tagged PRE_RELEASE_CONSENSUS_PRESERVED_ON_INVESTING_CALENDAR_RESEARCH_RECONSTRUCTION.
consensus_provider_policy.storage_policy: Research-only normalized fields and provenance metadata only; do not commit raw Investing.com HTML or bulk page content to the public repository; no redistribution; seek permission or replace provider before external/commercial deployment.
consensus_provider_policy.legal_classification_note: USER_ACCEPTED_LICENSE_RISK is a project governance label, not a legal conclusion. Investing.com terms currently restrict use/storage without prior written permission.

MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: release-date first print; later revisions must not overwrite the archived first print
